facts.text: Caroline expressed gratitude to Melanie for her support during her journey of self-acceptance and helping others.

evidence.quote: Thanks, Mel. Finding self-acceptance was a long process, but now I'm ready to offer love and support to those who need it.
Thanks, Melanie. Transitioning wasn't easy and acceptance wasn't either, but the help I got from friends, family and people I looked up to was invaluable.

facts.text: Caroline mentioned that the support from friends, family, and people she looked up to was invaluable in her journey of self-acceptance.

evidence.quote: The help I got from friends, family and people I looked up to was invaluable. They boosted me through tough times and helped me find out who I really am.

facts.text: Caroline stated that she wants to pass on the same support and comfort she received to others who need it.

evidence.quote: Now I'm ready to offer love and support to those who need it.
That's why I want to pass that same support to anyone who needs it. Bringing others comfort and helping them grow brings me such joy.

facts.text: Melanie expressed happiness and admiration for Caroline's journey of self-acceptance and her efforts to help others.

evidence.quote: I'm so happy for you, Caroline. You found your true self and now you're helping others. You're so inspiring!
